method: Revalidation of recorded Apalache and TLC jobs for the model inputs at commit. For each catalog entry, matching isolated Quint module contents and imports, check options, pinned toolchain, recorded solver verdict, raw log and fixed-witness endpoint were checked. Each row identifies its historical checker execution. Induction certificates are separate checks on the formal models.

source_identity: The commit and spec_tree identify the reference implementation and specification used to prepare these records. Compare the release tag against spec_tree, runner_sha256 and verified_model_blob_sha256.
certificate_references: The per-family P1 paths in its original certificates are relative to the original reproduction bundle. The P2 proof command and derivation are in spec/proofs/restore-authority-induction.md.
